# OneTrackMind

> Free planner for multi-day motorbike, 4x4 and self-drive trips. Plans a trip day by day on real roads: fuel stops and gaps, night stops and places to stay (filter by camping, guesthouse, hotel, self-catering, backpackers), sunset and weather, height profile, and a road grade for every stretch read for your vehicle. Built by riders, free for riders. Based in South Africa; strongest in South Africa, Namibia and Lesotho, works worldwide.

Road grades (same road, read per vehicle): Race (tar, smooth), Pre-jeep (graded gravel), Jeep (rough tracks), Pre-single (rocks, sand, river crossings; 4x4 or adventure bike), Single (bike single track or serious 4x4 terrain).

Founder: Ashley, 25 years in motorcycle retail (Ducati Cape Town, KTM Cape Town), adventure rider since the early 2000s, Simola Hill Climb racer. Stories: https://onetrackmind.co.za

## Pages

## Routes
- [Northern Namibia in the Tortoise](https://onetrackmind.online/routes/namibia-2020-tortoise/): Namibia · Etosha, Kunene, Skeleton Coast, 8 days. Ten days in a rented 4x4 camper: Etosha, Opuwo, Epupa Falls, Palmwag and down the Skeleton Coast to Walvis. Washed-away roads and blind river crossings after the rains.
- [Fish River Canyon and the Orange River](https://onetrackmind.online/routes/namibia-2020-orange-river/): Northern Cape · Southern Namibia, 4 days. Cape Town to Canyon Village in one 850 km day, the Fish River Canyon, the hot tar to Aus, then the Orange River road from Rosh Pinah to Noordoewer. Back over Piekenierskloof.
- [Destination Epupa Falls](https://onetrackmind.online/routes/namibia-2017-epupa/): Namibia · Fish River to Kunene, 7 days. Canyon Village, Sesriem, Swakopmund, Grootberg and north to Epupa Falls on the Angolan border, back via Opuwo and Windhoek. Sand, corrugations and long gaps between fuel.
- [Wild Coast to Cape Town](https://onetrackmind.online/routes/wild-coast-2019/): Eastern Cape · Garden Route · Klein Karoo, 5 days. Port St Johns down the old Transkei to Wavecrest, the Kei mouth pont, East London, Port Alfred, the Langkloof to Oudtshoorn and home through Seweweekspoort.
- [Montagu Pass, Seven Passes and Prince Alfred's](https://onetrackmind.online/routes/seven-passes-prince-alfred/): Garden Route · Outeniqua, 1 day. A loop from Louvain Guest Farm: down Montagu Pass, the old Seven Passes road through the forest to Knysna, then up Prince Alfred's Pass for a burger at De Vlugt.
- [Speedweek run to Hakskeenpan](https://onetrackmind.online/routes/speedweek-hakskeenpan/): Northern Cape · Kalahari, 4 days. Cape Town over Sutherland and Calvinia to Upington and out to Hakskeenpan for Speedweek. Home via Augrabies and Springbok.
- [EU Road Trip 2018: Mattighofen to Goodwood and back](https://onetrackmind.online/routes/eu-road-trip-2018/): Austria · Germany · Belgium · UK · France · Italy, 15 days. 5,609 km on two KTM 790 Dukes: Porsche Museum, Hockenheim, a lap of the Nürburgring, Spa, Aston Martin, Alfaholics, Brooklands, Goodwood Festival of Speed, the Riviera, Lucca, Tavullia, World Ducati Week, Modena and home over the Alps.
- [EU Road Trip 2019: KTM factory to San Marino MotoGP](https://onetrackmind.online/routes/eu-road-trip-2019/): Austria · Italy, 5 days. From the KTM factory in Mattighofen: Hohenwerfen and the ice caves, then over the Alps to Misano for the San Marino MotoGP, and back via Venice.
- [Motor Valley and EICMA in a Fiat 500](https://onetrackmind.online/routes/motor-valley-2017/): Italy · Emilia-Romagna, Veneto, Lombardy, Piedmont, 5 days. Milan to Bologna for Lamborghini, Pagani, Ducati and Ferrari, the back roads to Venice, EICMA in Milan, the Alfa Romeo museum at Arese, MV Agusta at Varese and the car museum in Turin.
- [Swartberg Pass and Meiringspoort](https://onetrackmind.online/routes/swartberg-loop/): Western Cape · Karoo, 2 days. Over the Swartberg Pass on gravel to Prince Albert for the night, then back through Meiringspoort on tar. The pass is narrow with steep hairpins; take it slowly and give way to cars coming down.
- [Die Hel (Gamkaskloof)](https://onetrackmind.online/routes/die-hel/): Western Cape · Swartberg, 1 day. Out and back from Prince Albert over the top of the Swartberg Pass and down the long, steep zigzags of the Elands Pass into Gamkaskloof. A dead end, so you ride it twice. Allow a full day, carry water and don't try it after heavy rain.
- [Tankwa Karoo and the Gannaga Pass](https://onetrackmind.online/routes/tankwa-gannaga/): Northern Cape · Tankwa, 2 days. Out of Ceres onto the long gravel of the Tankwa, up the Gannaga Pass to the Roggeveld and on to Sutherland for the night. Back down the Ouberg Pass the next day. Long stretches with no fuel: fill up in Ceres and Sutherland.
- [Cederberg traverse](https://onetrackmind.online/routes/cederberg-traverse/): Western Cape · Cederberg, 2 days. Clanwilliam over the Pakhuis Pass and down into Wupperthal, then south through the Cederberg to Ceres over the Katbakkies Pass. Sandy and rocky in places; easier on an adventure bike or a 4x4 than a road car.
- [Baviaanskloof](https://onetrackmind.online/routes/baviaanskloof/): Eastern Cape, 1 day. Willowmore to Patensie through the Baviaanskloof: mountain passes, river crossings and very few people. It's a long, slow day; most people stay a night in the kloof. Check conditions after rain, when the crossings can be deep.
- [Sani Pass](https://onetrackmind.online/routes/sani-pass/): KwaZulu-Natal · Lesotho border, 1 day. From Underberg up the Sani Pass to the Lesotho border post at the top, and back down. Bring your passport. The top switchbacks are steep and loose; conditions change fast in winter.
- [Namaqualand coast](https://onetrackmind.online/routes/namaqua-coast/): Northern Cape · Namaqualand, 2 days. Springbok down the Wildeperdehoek Pass to the coast at Hondeklipbaai for the night, then back inland via Garies and Kamieskroon. Best in flower season (August to September). Sand on the coastal tracks.
- [Seweweekspoort and the Ouberg Pass](https://onetrackmind.online/routes/seweweekspoort-ouberg/): Western Cape · Klein Karoo, 2 days. From Ladismith through the high walls of Seweweekspoort to Laingsburg for the night, then south over the Ouberg Pass to Montagu. Good gravel most of the way.
- [Windhoek to Sesriem](https://onetrackmind.online/routes/namib-sesriem/): Namibia, 2 days. Down off the Khomas Highland to Solitaire for the night, then on to Sesriem and the dunes. Gravel all the way after Windhoek. Tyre pressures down, speeds down: corrugations and loose shoulders cause most accidents here.
- [West Coast gravel](https://onetrackmind.online/routes/west-coast-gravel/): Western Cape · West Coast, 1 day. Elandsbaai up the coast to Lambert's Bay and Doringbaai, then inland to Vanrhynsdorp. Sandy in patches and windy most afternoons.
